headline: Newark is under a ground delay program; other hubs are running normally.

items.text: The FAA has a ground delay program for flights into Newark (EWR) until 11:59 PM ET because of low clouds, the only FAA program affecting a United hub right now. Those flights are held at their departure airport, with delays averaging 62 minutes and up to 140 minutes.
On time means within 30 minutes of schedule. All seven United hubs reporting so far today are at 85% or better, so the other hubs are running normally.
Network status is Some Delays, with a network disruption index of 31, in the minor-disruption range of 20 to 40.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Newark, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
